title: Animated Tooltip
subtitle: A label that follows the pointer or appears on hover.

descriptions.follow: The tooltip trails the cursor, or stays put next to the element.
descriptions.side: Which side of the element or cursor the tooltip sits on.
descriptions.sideOffset: Gap between the tooltip and what it points at, in Tailwind spacing units.
descriptions.changeAnimation: What happens when you move straight to another element: the text swaps, or the tooltip morphs to the new size.
descriptions.duration: How long the change between elements takes, in seconds. Not used by Swap text.
descriptions.elastic: The tooltip moves on a spring that can overshoot.
descriptions.bounce: Springiness of the movement. Does nothing with Elastic off and Change animation set to Swap text.
descriptions.stretchOnMove: The tooltip stretches in the direction it moves. Needs Elastic on.
descriptions.tiltOnMove: The tooltip leans into the direction it moves. Needs Elastic on.
descriptions.stiffness: How tightly the tooltip follows the cursor or glides between elements. Higher is snappier.
descriptions.appearAnimation: How the tooltip appears and disappears.
descriptions.closeDelay: How long the tooltip stays after the pointer leaves, in seconds.
